t: Exosymbiosis vs. Endosymbiosis: A Developer's Guide to the AI Platform Wars
s: This article frames the AI platform landscape as a conflict between corporate exosymbiosis (developers absorbed into large tech ecosystems) and personal endosymbiosis (developers internalizing AI tools). It analyzes the strategic implications of datacenter ownership, LLM architectures, and developer autonomy in this ongoing 'AI race'.
sub: Exosymbiosis vs. Endosymbiosis in AI Platform Adoption
Datacenter Ownership as a Strategic AI Platform Prerequisite
LLM Architectures: Agentic Mode and Fire-and-Forget Limitations
Developer Autonomy vs. Vendor Lock-in in the AI Ecosystem
